summary.en: Coast Guard bomb experts were wounded when explosives detonated inside their Zamboanga City barracks, and two other Coast Guard members were injured in a separate blast at the same location. The Philippine Coast Guard placed a five-day heightened alert for the Undas period, deployed personnel to rescue a distressed vessel in Tawi-Tawi, and prepared a large police deployment of over 72,000 personnel for the holiday. The Armed Forces of the Philippines monitored 54 Chinese vessels, including a carrier, transiting West Philippine Sea features from Oct. 20 to 26, and said the carrier passage off Mindanao was not a cause for alarm. Cyclone Arnab caused a Philippine ship to drift to the Konaseema coast, resulting in three deaths. 176 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Coast Guard-bombeeksperter ble såret da eksplosiver detonerte inne i deres barakk i Zamboanga City, og to andre Coast Guard-medlemmer ble skadet i en separat eksplosjon på samme sted. Philippine Coast Guard satte en fem-dagers høyere beredskap for Undas-perioden, satte inn personell for å redde et nødstilt skip i Tawi-Tawi, og forberedte en stor politideployering på over 72 000 personer for høytiden. De væpnede styrkene i Filippinene overvåket 54 kinesiske fartøyer, inkludert et hangarskip, som transitterte West Philippine Sea-områdene fra 20. til 26. oktober, og sa at passasjen til hangarskipet utenfor Mindanao ikke var grunn til alarm. Syklonen Arnab fikk et filippinsk skip til å drive mot kysten av Konaseema, noe som førte til tre dødsfall. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Moro conflict
background.extract: The Moro conflict was an insurgency in the Mindanao region in southern Philippines which involved multiple armed groups. A decades-long peace process has resulted in peace deals between the Philippine government and two major armed groups, the Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) and the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), but other smaller armed groups continue to exist. In 2017, the peace council settled around 138 clan conflicts.
